items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know nothin' about Stravinsky. So Bird was the first one to tell me about it.

ctx.x: Oh, I'm telling you, it was somethin' else, man. And Charlie Parker was mean. I learned a whole lot from that man, you know. Of course, I guess he learned something from me, too, but I really learned a lot from him. Because there was nothin' he couldn't play. He knew everything, and he hipped me to, like, Stravinsky and all
